# ModBus Pro (modbus.app)

> ModBus Pro is a Modbus diagnostic tool for Windows that combines a master (client) poller and a multi-device slave simulator in one desktop app, alongside free online Modbus reference guides, troubleshooting articles, and calculators.

Key product facts: supports Modbus RTU, TCP/IP, RTU-over-TCP and ASCII; function codes FC01-06, FC15, FC16, FC22, FC23; simulates up to 10 slave devices with all data formats (float32/int32/uint32 in every byte order); auto-discovery scans address ranges for live registers; built-in register maps for 84 industrial devices; request/response logging with timestamps and charts; scripting engine for automated test sequences. Runs on Windows 10/11. Free full-featured 7-day trial (no signup). One-time purchase from $199 (Personal), $749 (Team, 5 machines), $1,699 (Site, 10 machines) — no subscription. Download: https://modbus.app/#download

## Free online tools

- [Modbus address calculator](https://modbus.app/modbus-address-calculator.html): convert between 0-based, 1-based and 4xxxx register addressing
- [Number converter](https://modbus.app/number-converter.html): decimal, hex, binary and float32 conversion in every byte order
- [Frame parser](https://modbus.app/modbus-frame-parser.html): decode raw Modbus RTU/TCP frames with CRC check
- [Baud rate calculator](https://modbus.app/modbus-baud-rate-calculator.html): RS-485 character timing and timeout calculation

## Reference

- [Modbus function codes](https://modbus.app/modbus-function-codes.html): complete FC01-FC23 reference with request/response byte layouts
- [Modbus exception codes](https://modbus.app/exception-codes.html): all exception codes, meanings and fixes
- [Register offset and 40001 addressing](https://modbus.app/modbus-register-offset.html): 0-based vs 1-based addressing explained
- [Modbus RTU vs TCP](https://modbus.app/rtu-vs-tcp.html): differences and when to use each
- [How to read Modbus data](https://modbus.app/read-modbus-data.html): step-by-step beginner guide
